messages:
Rae (PM): starting a short thread to finalize DP onboarding acceptance criteria and QA choreography for incoming cohorts. need quick agreement on ops handoffs.
Bea (PartnerOps): TL;DR: intake -> score -> NDA -> smoke eval -> kickoff. Recommend automated score threshold to auto-accept vs manual review.
Omar (Eng): agree. For auto-accept we need a safe default quota + sandbox provision. propose: auto-provision api-key + 7-day sandbox with quotas capped at 500k tokens.
Luca (Res): research requirement: collect 2 seed prompts + 1 stress prompt at intake. also request a brief success metric (e.g., conversion, reply rate).
Rae (PM): acceptance rubric suggestion: score >= 13 -> auto-accept; 10-12 -> PO review; <10 -> nurture. Scores from: technical fit, data sensitivity, readiness, expected impact (0-5 each).
Sam (Legal): intake must include a checkbox: "I consent to pilot terms and optional telemetry sharing." If PHI/FIN flagged, route to Legal automatically.
Bea (PartnerOps): intake draft snippet: 
```
- Company name
- Contact
- Use case (1-2 lines)
- 2 sample prompts + stress prompt
- Expected weekly tokens
- Any regulatory flags (PHI/FIN/GOV)
- Preferred cohort window
```
Omar (Eng): infra gates: freeze model config 72h before cohort start. provide a fallback model on all pilots. add a rate-limited webhook that posts smoke-eval results to cohort channel.
notify-bot: automation created: non-responder pings at day 3 and day 8; manual escalate to PO on day 10.
Luca (Res): QA choreography: after intake, run automated smoke eval (10-min). If smoke passes (>=60% happy-path), schedule deep session. If fails, send triage template and request 1-hour debugging call.
Rae (PM): launch gates per cohort: 1) seats filled >=75%, 2) >=60% smoke-eval completion, 3) at least 1 partner with passing smoke eval, 4) runbook + playbook validated by Eng/Res.
Bea (PartnerOps): incentives: base 300 credits; milestone 700 if they complete 3 weekly evals + feedback interview. co-marketing reserved for enterprise partners.
Sam (Legal): add short TOS link in the invite and an easy opt-out for telemetry. we'll prefill standard NDA for small partners, enterprise gets custom.
Omar (Eng): owners: Bea = intake & comms, Omar = infra & webhook, Luca = eval config, Sam = legal checks, Rae = launch decision. target: intake form live Thu, send batch next Mon.
Rae (PM): final check: can everyone live with the 72h model freeze and the auto-accept quota?
Omar (Eng): yes from infra side.
Luca (Res): yes. we want the seed prompts early so we can sanity-check.
Bea (PartnerOps): on it. I'll post invite copy to #product-docs for a 24h review window and queue the automation.
Rae (PM): perfect. I'll schedule a 15-min review Fri. thanks all :seedling:
